art: Premium dark editorial art direction for a boutique web-design studio's portfolio: deep ink-black and warm stone, thin gold highlights, cinematic soft light, photorealistic or refined 3D render. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

jobs.prompt: A cinematic dark studio desk at night seen from a low angle: a large widescreen monitor displaying an elegant abstract luxury website layout (only abstract shapes and soft gold lines, no readable text), beside it a mechanical keyboard, a notebook with design sketches, a fountain pen and a glass of whisky, warm amber lamp light with deep navy shadows, shallow depth of field.

Overhead flat-lay on a dark stone surface of a designer's tools: printed wireframe sketches, colour swatches in muted tones, a gold-tipped pencil, a metal ruler, a small brass compass and a tablet showing an abstract layout without readable text, soft side light.

logo.concept: a minimalist studio emblem: a capital letter L built from one continuous thin line, enclosed in a tilted square diamond outline, precise and elegant

icons.style: engraved gold monoline icons with fine hairlines, Art Deco inspired, elegant
items: a browser window with a layout wireframe inside
a fountain pen nib drawing a curve
a globe with latitude lines and a small chat bubble
a stopwatch with a lightning bolt
a camera lens with an aperture star
a rising paper-plane trail forming an arrow
